--- field name contains 'binocular' / 'monoscop' / 'stereoscop' 0 hit(s)


# EVERY record whose DEVELOPER COMMENT mentions stereo (the second search
# surface: the reflection DB carries id's own doc comments).

  bool inhibitModelFovScale
      // For steroescopic 3D rendering, we don't want to allow the hands/weapons to use a custom (inconsistant) FOV

  idScreenRect screenRect
      // coordinates should be a subset of renderSystem->GetScanoutWidth() / GetScanoutHeight() which can be larger than GetWidth() / GetHeight() when in stereo 3D modes

  float guiOriginOffset
      // for stereo 3D, the guis can be offset differently in each screenView

  idStaticList < idScreenView , 1 , false , TAG_IDLIST > screenViews
      // There is typically a single screenView, but split-screen multiplayer or stereo-3D will define two views. Guis inside screenViews are potentially resolution scaled, but they will be persistant across frames. The views are processed in order, so a main menu gui that draws across both split screen views must be in a screenView (without a world) after them.

  idStaticList < idScreenView , 2 , false , TAG_IDLIST > worldViews
      // The world views that will be used to call idRenderModel::UpdateInView. There is normally just one, but there will be two unique ones in split-screen multiplayer and two identical ones in stereo-3D (both centered between the eyes).

  float z
      // This is to allow sprites to "pop out" of the screen This is only useful in stereoscopic rendering or in-world
